title: A worker blocker becomes attention at once, prompts the master, and stays with the Master however long it waits
description: GY-3280: on a fixture install, a worker blocker on an item becomes an attention line in master status within one cycle naming the item, the blocker and how long it has waited, and delivers a prompt to the master session naming both. GY-3394: the blocker is the Master's however long it stands — 40 minutes unanswered raises nothing on Needs you. The command step proves the loop-side behaviour on the cycle fixture; the seed, HTTP and browser steps prove the served fixture's dashboard: both the aged and the fresh blocker stay in the board's Blocked group, the human-only list carries neither, the Master page shows the aged one, and the operator's unblock clears it and returns the item to waiting for a worker.
